node.title: A rank-eight owner flat has a universal owner-pair weight cap
node.closure: independent coordinate-pair interpolation plus the fixed-owner slope cap
node.statement: Fix a rank-eight nine-subset B in a residual row n'=1048576+K'. If W_B counts affine-owner component eleven-subsets containing B over all assigned records, then W_B <= 981105*C(n'-9,2). Every full-rank two-coordinate extension determines at most one owner pair in the affine U^2 flat, while one fixed owner pair owns at most 981105 selected records. This is an incidence-weight cap and does not pay the lower-shortening rank-eight route.
